jobs.title: Arztsekretär/in (60-70%)
jobs.description:
Per 1. Dezember 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Sekretariat-Teams der Gruppe Kinderchirurgie/Tagesklinik eine Arztsekretär/in.

Ihre Aufgaben
• Telefonischer Kontakt mit Patientinnen, Patienten und deren Angehörigen sowie weiteren internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
• Organisation und Koordination von anspruchsvollen Terminen und Versand der Aufgebote
• Bearbeitung von allgemeinen administrativen Aufgaben im Sekretariatsbereich
• Bearbeitung und Koordination des Posteingangs (Briefpost und E-Mails)
• Bewirtschaftung der Patientenakten (elektronisch und in Papierform)
• Erstellen, Redigieren und Versenden von anspruchsvoller medizinischer Korrespondenz

Ihr Profil
• Abschluss der Ausbildung zur/zum medizinischen Praxisassistent/in oder kaufmännischen Grundausbildung im medizinischen Bereich und eine Weiterbildung zur/zum medizinischen Sekretär/in
• Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in medizinischer Terminologie sowie ein stilsicherer Umgang mit der deutschen Sprache in Kommunikation und Korrespondenz
• Strukturierte, exakte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
• Empathische, teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit schneller Auffassungsgabe
• Arbeitstage: Dienstag, Mittwoch, Freitag
• Die Ferien wären hauptsächlich ausserhalb der Schulferien zu beziehen

Wir bieten Ihnen
• Verantwortung, weil wir auf die Kompetenz unserer Mitarbeitenden vertrauen
• Perspektiven, weil wir uns zusammen mit Ihnen stetig weiterentwickeln
• Wissen, weil wir die interne und externe Weiterbildung fördern
• Teamwork, weil wir wissen, dass wir das Ziel nur gemeinsam erreichen

Ihr Arbeitsbereich
Die Sekretariatsmitarbeitenden der verschiedenen Fachbereiche sind zuständig für die alltäglichen Sekretariatsarbeiten, wie beispielsweise das Aufgebotswesen, allgemeiner Korrespondenz und die Erfassung von Leistungen. Sie unterstützen das medizinische Fachpersonal bei der Sprechstundenvorbereitung und stellen eine professionelle interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sicher. Die Sekretariate sind in 6 Gruppen nach Fachbereich mit jeweils einer zuständigen Gruppenleitung gegliedert: Adoleszentenmedizin & Pädiatrische Psychosomatik, Kinder- & Jugendmedizin, Kinderchirurgie & Tagesklinik, Orthopädie, KER-Zentrum und Stationen. Das fachübergreifende Medizinische Sekretariat unterstützt die einzelnen Gruppen zusätzlich im administrativen Bereich, vorwiegend in im Berichtswesen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A partire dal 1o dicembre 2026 o d'accordo, stiamo cercando un segretario medico per rafforzare il nostro team di segreteria del gruppo di chirurgia pediatrica / clinica quotidiana.

I loro compiti
• Contatto telefonico con i pazienti e i loro parenti e altri contatti interni ed esterni
• Organizzazione e coordinamento di appuntamenti esigenti e invio di ordini
• Gestione dei compiti amministrativi generali nel settore della segreteria
• Lavorazione e coordinamento della casella di posta (lettera posta e posta elettronica)
• Gestione dei registri dei pazienti (elettronica e carta)
• Creare, modificare e inviare una corrispondenza medica sofisticata

Il tuo profilo
• Completamento della formazione come assistente di pratica medica o formazione di base commerciale nel settore medico e ulteriore formazione come segretario medico
• Esperienza professionale in una capacità simile
• Molto buona conoscenza della terminologia medica e una gestione elegante della lingua tedesca in comunicazione e corrispondenza
• Metodo di lavoro strutturato, preciso e indipendente
• Empatico, personalità orientata al team con rapida comprensione
• Giorni di lavoro: martedì, mercoledì, venerdì
• Le vacanze sarebbero principalmente al di fuori delle vacanze scolastiche

Noi li offriamo
• Responsabilità perché ci fidiamo della competenza dei nostri dipendenti
• Prospettive, perché stiamo costantemente sviluppando insieme a voi
• Conoscenza perché promuoviamo la formazione interna ed esterna
• Lavoro di squadra, perché sappiamo che raggiungeremo solo l'obiettivo insieme

La tua area di lavoro
Il personale della segreteria nei vari dipartimenti è responsabile del lavoro di segreteria di giorno per giorno, come la contingenza, la corrispondenza generale e la raccolta dei servizi. Essi sostengono gli specialisti medici nella preparazione delle ore di ufficio e assicurano la cooperazione interdisciplinare professionale. I segretariati sono suddivisi in 6 gruppi per reparto con una gestione responsabile del gruppo: Medicina Adolescente & Psicosomatica Pediatrica, Medicina Pediatrica e Adolescente, Chirurgia Pediatrica & Day Clinic, Ortopedia, Centro KER e Stazioni. Il segretariato medico interdisciplinare supporta inoltre i singoli gruppi nell'area amministrativa, principalmente nel reporting.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As of 1 December 2026 or by agreement, we are looking for a medical secretary to reinforce our secretarial team of the paediatric surgery/day clinic group.

Their tasks
• Telephone contact with patients and their relatives as well as other internal and external contacts
• Organization and coordination of demanding appointments and dispatch of orders
• Management of general administrative tasks in the secretarial area
• Processing and coordination of the inbox (letter post and e-mails)
• Management of patient records (electronic and paper)
• Creating, editing and sending sophisticated medical correspondence

Your profile
• Completion of training as medical practice assistant or commercial basic training in the medical sector and further training as medical secretary
• Professional experience in a similar capacity
• Very good knowledge of medical terminology as well as a stylish handling of the German language in communication and correspondence
• Structured, exact and independent working method
• Empathetic, team-oriented personality with quick comprehension
• Working days: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday
• The holidays would be mainly outside the school holidays

We offer them
• Responsibility because we trust in the competence of our employees
• Perspectives, because we are constantly developing together with you
• Knowledge because we promote internal and external training
• Teamwork, because we know that we only achieve the goal together

Your work area
Secretarial staff in the various departments are responsible for day-to-day secretarial work, such as contingency, general correspondence and the collection of services. They support medical specialists in the preparation of office hours and ensure professional interdisciplinary cooperation. The secretariats are divided into 6 groups by department with a responsible group management: Adolescent Medicine & Pediatric Psychosomatics, Pediatric & Adolescent Medicine, Pediatric Surgery & Day Clinic, Orthopaedics, KER Centre and Stations. The interdisciplinary medical secretariat additionally supports the individual groups in the administrative area, mainly in reporting.

• Sie lernen schwerkranke Kinder und Jugendliche nach den neuesten pflegefachlichen und pflegetechnischen Erkenntnissen zu pflegen

• Sie verfügen über mindestens 12 Monate Berufserfahrung in der akuten Krankenpflege
• Sie haben Freude am Beruf, das Interesse und die Motivation sich auf das NDS HF IPP einzulassen
• Sie bewegen sich sicher, sind neugierig und kooperativ in der multidisziplinären Zusammenarbeit

• Teamwork, weil wir wissen, dass wir das Ziel nur gemeinsam erreichen

Die Pflege ist ein spannender und sinnstiftender Beruf mit vielseitigen Aufgaben. Unser Ausbildungsangebot bietet ebenso vielfältige Möglichkeiten – von verschiedenen Praktika über die dreijährige Berufslehre Fachfrau/-mann Gesundheit (FaGe) bis zur dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF und Nachdiplomstudiengänge in der Notfall- oder Intensivpflege.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are continuously looking for the neonatal and pediatric intensive care unit Dipl. Nursing professionals HF for postgraduate studies Higher School Intensive Care Paediatrics NDS HF IPP

Their tasks
• You move in the field of highly specialized medicine and deepen your knowledge in the fields of intensive care, intensive care and equipment technology
• They learn to nurse seriously ill children and adolescents according to the latest nursing and nursing knowledge
• With the support of proven and motivated specialists, they accompany children and young people and their caregivers in experiencing and coping with the current disease situation.

Your profile
• You have a nursing diploma HF, DN 2 diploma, general nursing care, paediatric nursing care or an equivalent nursing diploma recognised by the Swiss Red Cross
• You have at least 12 months of professional experience in acute care
• You enjoy the profession, the interest and the motivation to get involved in the NDS HF IPP
• They move safely, are curious and cooperative in multidisciplinary cooperation

We offer them
• Responsibility because we trust in the competence of our employees
• Perspectives, because we are constantly developing together with you
• Knowledge because we promote internal and external training
• Teamwork, because we know that we only achieve the goal together

Your work area
Care is an exciting and meaningful profession with a variety of tasks. Our training offer also offers a wide range of possibilities – from various internships to the three-year apprenticeship Fachfrau/-mann Gesundheit (FaGe) to the dipl. Nursing specialist HF and postgraduate courses in emergency or intensive care.

Further information on further and further training in nursing can be found here: Training & further education.

Family and development-promoting care and care are our focus. Ihr Arbeitsbereich
Das Fachgebiet der pädiatrischen Infektiologie / Kinderinfektiologie befasst sich mit der Prävention, Diagnostik und Therapie von Infektionskrankheiten im Neugeborenen-, Säuglings-, Kindes- und Jugendalter. We are looking for you as an expert in the field of infection prevention to support our experienced and committed team.

Their tasks

• Cooperation in networks and exchange with relevant internal and external expert bodies

Your profile

Your work area
The specialty of pediatric infectiology / paediatric infectiology deals with the prevention, diagnosis and therapy of infectious diseases in neonatal, infant, childhood and adolescence. Child infectiology is a very broad field of expertise, because all organs can be affected by infections. Infection prevention in pediatrics is particularly versatile, as the clinic and infection pathways of infections in children are often different from those in adulthood. The central task of infection prevention is at the same time to prevent infections acquired in the hospital (nosocomial infections) and the formation and spread of resistant germs.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for 1. 2026, or sooner, a reinforcement for the senior medical team of our neonatology and pediatric intensive care in the new building of the Eastern Swiss Children's Hospital.

Their tasks
• Medical care for children in all sectors of our station
• Participation in the medical pikett service and neonatal transport in the foundation area (ground and air bound)
• Training of assistant physicians and fellows (continuing training empowerment neonatology 36 months and intensive care medicine 18 months)

Your profile
• Enthusiastic personality with passion for their clinical activity
• Specialist title Pediatrics and Adolescent Medicine
• Main title Neonatology or the willingness to acquire it from us
• A specialist title intensive medicine (or an advanced training) would be almost ideal, but is not a requirement

We offer them
• First-class working environment, because our new building of the Eastern Swiss Children's Hospital with a state-of-the-art neonatology and pediatric intensive care unit with a total of 40 beds offers the best conditions for your everyday work
• Teamwork, because a committed interprofessional team of doctors, nurses and other specialists together achieves the best for our patients every day
• Prospects, because the region of St. Gallen with its high quality of life, the proximity to Lake Constance and the mountains as well as various leisure opportunities offers ideal conditions for work and private life

Your work area
With us you will find a challenging and exciting field of activity, which, apart from cardiosurgery and transplantation medicine, covers the entire spectrum of modern neonatology and pediatric intensive care medicine. In our intensive care unit, we operate 10 SGI-certified ventilation stations for the smallest premature babies from 24 SSW up to adolescent patients with life-threatening diseases. Together with the obstetrics of the HOCH (Cantonsspital St. Gallen) we form a perinatal center of the highest level of care. With the other maternity clinics in the foundation area, we are responsible for more than 8,000 births per year and provide annual care for around 100 premature babies under 1,500 g.

• Facharzttitel Kinder- und Jugendmedizin und klinische Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Kindern und Jugendlichen mit komplexen Erkrankungen

• Eine Tätigkeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen hochspezialisierter Pädiatrie, ambulanter Betreuung und Begleitung im häuslichen Umfeld

Sie umfasst alle Aspekte der Medizin, Pflege und Begleitung und ist Ausdruck einer Haltung dem Leben und dem Menschen gegenüber, die sich nicht auf das unmittelbare Lebensende beschränken soll.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di stagisti il 1 febbraio e 1 agosto per un minimo. Stage di 6 mesi in allattamento.

• svolgere semplici attività di cura sotto la guida di professionisti;
• Essi effettuano visite di messaggero e accompagnano i pazienti agli esami

• Sono socievoli e godono di avere a che fare con i bambini
• Sono curiosi e hanno una buona comprensione
• Sono resilienti e hanno la capacità di delinearsi

Noi li offriamo
• Responsabilità perché ci fidiamo della competenza dei nostri dipendenti
• Prospettive, perché stiamo costantemente sviluppando insieme a voi
